title: Lofts At 30th-Nashville Charm -In West End
description:
Step into our unit at Lofts at 30th, where luxury meets convenience. Nestled in the heart of the vibrant West End Corridor, this exquisite space offers unparalleled proximity to Centennial Park, Vanderbilt University, premier shopping destinations, and a myriad of dining and entertainment options. Situated just a short 6-minute drive from Broadway, the epicenter of Nashville's nightlife, this location ensures you're never far from the action.

The space
Each unit comes with a fully equipped kitchen, complete with essential cooking supplies, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. Enjoy entertainment with smart TVs in both the living room and bedroom. Experience ultimate comfort with a Queen bed, ensuring a restful night's sleep. The perfect home base for your stay also includes a pull-out sofa. It also has an air mattress in the closet.

Bed Setup:
- 1 Queen bed
- 1 Pull Out Queen Sofa
- 1 Air Mattress  (stored in closet)

- An elevator is available in the complex to transport you to the 3rd floor.
- Complimentary parking is provided on the premises. All numbered spaces in the parking garage are accessible for use, and there is a limit to one car per reservation. 
Additional street parking is offered on a first-come, first-served basis.

Permit #2024020741

Guest access
Full access to the unit.
